description: React component for the Login page, handling user authentication via email/password and Google Sign-In using Google Identity Services. It manages form state, integrates with external APIs and services, and renders the login UI.

methods.name: Login()
methods.description: React functional component that renders a login form with email/password and Google Sign-In integration.

methods.name: handleGoogleCredential
methods.description: Handles the credential response from Google Identity Services, exchanges the token with backend, stores tokens, and redirects user.

methods.name: useEffect
methods.description: Initializes Google Identity Services SDK and renders the Google Sign-In button on component mount.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission for email/password login, calls signIn method, manages state, and redirects upon success.
